title: Seagrove Beach "Wine'd Down" 498 Eastern Lake Rd
h1: Seagrove Beach "Wine'd Down" 498 Eastern Lake Rd
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Steps to the Beach!! - Gulf & lake views- Gas grill- 7 adult bikes- 6-passenger Low-Speed Vehicle- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Wine’d Down is a beautiful home with lovely views! Located in the popular Seagrove Beach community, this 3-story property sleeps up to 18 guests with 7 bedrooms. The spacious floor plan includes a great room, an efficiency suite with a private entrance, and 2 wraparound decks. And just 12 steps from the boardwalk to the beach, you'll have plenty of fun in the sun!As you enter the first floor, you'll appreciate the additional space you get from this efficiency suite. Replete with a small couch, TV, 4-seat table, and kitchenette with fridge and microwave—kids and teenagers will love co-opting this extra living area. If stairs are a problem, the queen bed and private bath make for a comfy guest bedroom. This floor also has two newly renovated guest rooms, one with a queen bed and another with a queen-over-queen bunk bed.Upstairs, guests will enjoy the spacious layout that connects the living, dining, and kitchen areas on the second floor. With natural décor throughout, the subtle beachy vibes make you feel at home. Lounge on the cream-colored sectional couch or enjoy dinner at the 6-seat dining room table. The adjacent chef's kitchen includes luxurious details like quartz countertops, French-door refrigerator, 4-stool breakfast bar, and wine fridge. Down the hallway, you’ll discover the full-size washer and dryer in the communal bathroom and 2 guest bedrooms—1 queen bed and 2 adult twin-over-twin bunk beds, both with shared bathrooms.As you venture to the third floor, you will find 2 roomy suites designed to highlight the gorgeous Gulf views. Both include king-sized beds, private baths, and access to the balcony. From the second and third floors, enjoy fabulous views of the Gulf and Dune Lake from the wraparound decks, complete with outdoor furniture and private gas grill.If you're looking for an outdoor adventure, explore the area on the provided Low-Speed Vehicle or adult bikes. Book Wine’d Down now for an incredible Florida Coast retreat! Estimated completion date TBD.

Located in the popular Seagrove Beach community, this 3-story property sleeps up to 18 guests with 7 bedrooms. The spacious floor plan includes a great room, an efficiency suite with a private entrance, and 2 wraparound decks. And just 12 steps from the boardwalk to the beach, you'll have plenty of fun in the sun! As you enter the first floor, you'll appreciate the additional space you get from this efficiency suite.
